name: n4_read_file
description: Read one station file (e.g. a Px view file:^px/General.px) through the station's file servlet: GET /file/<path>. file_ord is a file:^ ORD or a path relative to the station home. Refused before any request: '..', '|', ':', absolute paths, directories, names ending in '.' or ' ' and .bog/.bog.gz (the station never serves them). Text types (px, xml, nav, chart, json, csv, html, txt, ...) return text; other files return size, sha256 and content type only (output_file saves the complete bytes under <state-dir>/files/). status is ok, forbidden (403: no read permission) or not_found (404); a 401 pauses station calls and is never retried. Reads are capped at max_bytes (truncated=true, sha256 null when cut).

output_file.description: Optional plain file name with an extension: the complete bytes go to <state-dir>/files/<name> (0600, never overwritten)
